svg.text: Pick group, round, time, room, panel and chair
POST /api/v1/reviews (groupId, round, scheduledAt, room, panel, chairId)
Check the group has an approved topic and the date is in the round's semester week
Save review session and panel, outbox REVIEW_SCHEDULED
Copy every Review 1 not yet copied, shifted by offsetDays
200 Created sessions (400 unless Review 1 to Review 2)
Save result (Review 3: READY_FOR_DEFENSE_1, REVISE_BEFORE_DEFENSE_1 or DEFER_TO_DEFENSE_2)
Confirm the group finished its revision
409 The group must go to Defense 2
Pick group, attempt, time, room, committee
POST /api/v1/defenses (groupId, attempt, scheduledAt, room, committeeIds, chairId)
Pick groups, first start, duration, break
Check the Review 3 outcome allows this attempt
Enter pass or fail, score, feedback
Defense FAILED, the group goes to Defense 2
